title: Null control: Bandar Abbas heat -> SPY 5d
hypothesis: R2 | [oil-shipping] Null control: Bandar Abbas temp anomaly 20d z-score > 1.5 leads SPY log returns by 5 days (+); trade long SPY 5d - if this also "works", the XOP/SPY result is market beta not heat stress [weather.bandar_abbas.temp_anomaly -> finance.SPY.log_return] (parent: R2-0012)

trade_idea.entry_rule: weather.bandar_abbas.temp_anomaly rolling_zscore_20d > 1 at close -> long SPY next session
trade_idea.exit_rule: close after 1 trading days (no overlapping entries)
trade_idea.caveats: Backtest on daily closes, no costs/slippage; few independent regimes; signal and target may share the war as common cause.

followup_hypothesis: R2 | [oil-shipping] Paired control: Bandar Abbas temp anomaly 20d z-score > 1.5 leads the XOP/SPY ratio by 5 days (+) over the pre-war window only; if the excess return vanishes outside the war regime, the heat-stress effect is war-regime beta rather than a weather signal [weather.bandar_abbas.temp_anomaly -> finance.ratio.xop_spy] (parent: R2-0109)
